_comment: Belt program. Copy to belts.json (set BELTS_FILE to use another path). Each entry has a name (as shown in the city) or an email, a belt (white, blue, purple, brown or black) and, optionally, since (YYYY-MM-DD). Every belt counts for the city's Dojo and appears in its sheet; only black belts change the building on the map (a black pagoda).
